name: aomega-m3-pairing-propagation-closes
description: The GGM pairing propagation law derived with no free parameters and verified to close exactly against printed (92); supersedes the Parts 3-5 blocker.
verdict: GATE 1 DONE. The pairing propagation law closes EXACTLY against GGM's printed (92), derived end-to-end with no free parameters from (86), (88), (87) and Theorem 11 — the last of which supplies the W^- law without a further lookup, since it makes BOTH branches of (87) solve (86). The law is P_{m+1} = A_{m-1} P_m R ([R Abar_{-m-2} R]^T)^{-1} R. It is verified at eight explicit integer m with q carrying NO assumptions (G1), and symbolically in m under positivity (G2). This SUPERSEDES the blocker of Parts 3-5, whose three causes were: Part 3's retracted m-invariance premise; the genuine structural point that (87) makes W at q^-1 a DIFFERENT block family (found by Part 6's source read); and a sympy artifact — with q unassumed, (1/q)^m does not fold to q^-m, so entry (1,0) displayed as q**m - 1/(1/q)**m, identically zero. ONE of the three was mathematics and TWO were the harness. Caveat recorded rather than smoothed over: that nonzero DISPLAY is path-dependent and this probe's own path simplifies the entry to 0 outright, so only the vanishing is reproducible here (G3). A residue that reads zero or nonzero depending on how simplify is reached is a worse hazard than a stable one.

assertions.name: G1-the derived propagation law closes EXACTLY at eight explicit integer m with q carrying NO assumptions — so the result does not rest on declaring q positive, which is precisely what masked the artifact in Parts 3-5
G2-the same law closes symbolically in m once q is positive and m is an integer

G3-the Parts 3-5 residue was NOT mathematics: entry (1,0) of the unassumed symbolic residue vanishes. Note this probe's path simplifies it to 0 outright, so the literal display 'q**m - 1/(1/q)**m' seen in the ad-hoc run is NOT reproduced here — the artifact is PATH-DEPENDENT, which makes it a worse hazard than a stable one, not a better one: the same residue can read zero or nonzero depending on how simplify is reached
